slides.texte_overlay:
7 changes that make you a
different man in 6 months
Wake up at the same time every day. Weekends too. A steady rhythm improves your sleep, your mood and your focus faster than any supplement or productivity trick.
Learn to cook three healthy meals by heart. No recipe needed. Eating well becomes easy and automatic, and your body slowly changes without any strict dieting.
Spend one hour a week on your finances. Track what you spend, plan the month, save a little. Six months later, money feels calm and under control instead of stressful.
Take one class in something that scares you. Public speaking, dance, a language. Doing hard things on purpose, again and again, builds a new and deeper kind of confidence.
Feed your head daily. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and six months of tiny lessons made me a sharper, more interesting man.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Six months of tiny lessons made me sharper and more interesting.

slides.texte_overlay: Walk outside every day without headphones. Thirty minutes of fresh air and your own thoughts clears your mind and lifts your mood like nothing else can.
Write down your progress each month. A short note and a photo. Seeing how far you've come in black and white keeps you going on the days motivation drops.
